newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazilian GDP grows in Q2, H1 over 1996 - IBGE.
newsitem.headline: Brazilian GDP grows in Q2, H1 over 1996 - IBGE.

text.p: Brazilian gross domestic product (GDP) grew 4.96 percent in second quarter 1997 compared with the same period in 1996 and 4.34 percent in the first half compared with last year, the National Statistics Institute said.
Seasonally adjusted, second quarter GDP rose 3.29 percent over the previous three months.
Compared with the second quarter of 1996, the 1997 result reflected growth rates of 8.57 percent in agriculture, 10.28 percent in mineral extraction and 8.71 percent in construction.
The second quarter result meant the GDP rose 5.12 percent in the twelve months between July 1996 and end-June 1997 compared with the same period in 1995/96, the IBGE said.

During the first half of this year, the 4.34 percent rise over the same period in 1996 reflected growth in most sectors, particularly in mineral extraction, of 8.35 percent, public services, of 7.14 percent, and construction, of 8.29 percent. ((-- Caroline Bulloch, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151))
